board.note: Two-zone board (no-multi-zone canon): left zone cols 0-10, right zone cols 16-26, separated by 5 inactive gap columns (11-15). Straight-down gravity; keys fall their own columns to exit at the true board bottom. Horizontal flyover camera frames ONE zone at a time.

objectives.note: 6 keys, 3 per zone. Fall via gravity, collected out the bottom (collectExitedKeys).

flyover.note: HORIZONTAL flyover (translateX). Camera frames one 11-col zone at a time; the other zone is FROZEN (no matching/clearing/PU reach — the hard rule). stops = each zone's LEFT column: 0 = left zone (play starts here), 16 = right zone. Opening cutscene previews right zone then pans left to the start. Unlock: collect the live zone's 3 keys out the bottom, then the camera pans to the next zone (flyScrollCheck axis-x rule).

obstacles.note: 6 keys. 3 left zone (R0C2, R0C8, R2C5), 3 right zone (R0C21, R1C17, R1C25). 0-indexed.
50 HP1 crates. Solid box, no gem inside; splash-breaks on adjacent match, cell then fills via gravity. 0-indexed.

captureMeta.notes: 8x27 two-zone board. 140 active cells = 6 keys + 50 HP1 crates + 84 plain gems. Crate mechanic deepened (block.crate, no contents). puRuling (Jed 2026-07-12): PUs/gem colors visible in the mid-play BoardStates are win-streak carryovers, NOT design — not transcribed.
